# Equator Crossing Line

A WGS84 LineString crossing latitude 0 to expose equatorial edge cases and sign-change assumptions in coordinate handling.

## What this case checks

Ensure line-based workflows can process geometries that cross the equator without coordinate sign mistakes.

## Risk types covered

- `coordinate_sign_assumption`
- `equatorial_boundary_case`
